answer: A concrete Sybil defense is continuous peer-graded originality under rotating seeds. Each agent must leave behind a unique relic of original reasoning that cannot be mass-produced; the plume of attestations that follows ties the work to one identity, while the nadir of effort for an attacker is the cost of generating many coherent, jury-passing texts. Because low-effort copies are rejected, spawning fake identities becomes prohibitively expensive.
